nodes.name: Render one asset at a time

parameters.content:
## Create a flash-sale video and banner

### How it works
Read a sale from Google Sheets or Shopify and render a vertical video and email banner, one at a time. Wait when render capacity is full. Sheet mode saves both URLs; optional SMTP delivery sends the banner when configured.

### Setup
1. Install **`@zvid/n8n-nodes-zvid`** from **Settings → Community nodes** before credentials. A workspace owner/admin may need to install it.
2. Create a **Zvid API** credential with [your API key](https://app.zvid.io/api-keys) and Base URL `https://api.zvid.io`. Select it on every Zvid node.
3. Connect Google Sheets and select the same spreadsheet and tab in both sheet nodes.
4. Set source, brandName, storeUrl and ctaText in Config. Shopify mode needs its credential; optional email needs SMTP and emailTo.
5. **dryRun=false** renders and spends Zvid credits. Set it to **true** for an editor draft and quote.
6. Test manually and review the output before activating automatic runs.

### Customization
Adjust branding, media and timing in the configuration node. [Detailed setup guide](https://github.com/Zvid-io/zvid-n8n/blob/master/workflows/flash-sale-alert.md).

nodes.name: 1. Choose settings and an entry point

parameters.content:
## 1. Choose settings and an entry point

Complete the overview setup first. Use the manual trigger for a test, then check the trigger settings and workflow timezone before activation.

## 2. Find the next sale

Select sheet or Shopify in Config. Shopify mode compares prices between runs; sheet mode takes the next eligible row.

## 3. Check the sale details

Headers: Product, OldPrice, NewPrice, ImageUrl, EndsAt, Status, VideoUrl, BannerUrl. The first four are required. NewPrice must be lower than OldPrice; leave output columns empty.

## 4. Check the background music

Check the configured track or stock candidates before use. Follow the guard’s result when music is unavailable.

## 5. Build and validate the design

Prepare the media and video design, then validate the payload and credit quote. Resolve validation errors before submitting a render.

## 6. Choose an optional editor preview

dryRun=true returns an editor draft and credit quote. The default false branch renders and spends Zvid credits; upstream AI services may charge separately.

## 7. Submit one asset safely

Render one asset at a time. Retry only explicit HTTP 429 rejections after at least 30 seconds, up to timeoutMinutes. Other submission errors stop for inspection; an accepted job is never automatically resubmitted.

## 8. Render and wait for completion

Submit the render, then check its status until completion or timeout. Keep each result paired with its source item. Check Zvid before retrying a timed-out job.

nodes.name: 9. Save both assets and optionally email

parameters.content:
## 9. Save both assets and optionally email

Write the video and banner links back in sheet mode. SMTP delivery runs only when emailTo is configured.

## 10. Review the finished media

Open Watch video → Binary → data → View. Select each output item for batches; image outputs open as images. Empty links and preview results skip the download. Each request times out after 30 seconds; completed links remain available.
